trace.notice: This lookup uses the task’s exact request ID. A trace may be unavailable or outside your access; this does not change the task status.

outputs.title: Returned task outputs
outputs.scope: Inspect the typed result returned for this task. File and media addresses are descriptions only; this view does not fetch, decode, or grant download access.
outputs.unavailable: This result does not match the current task/request, or this view is no longer current. Refresh the task to check again.
outputs.empty: The result contains no output items. This does not change the task receipt status.
outputs.descriptor: This item is shown as a descriptor. No remote content is loaded and no file encoding is inferred.
outputs.truncated: Limited preview: at most 16,000 characters with bounded JSON depth and entries. Copy includes only this displayed excerpt, not the full output.
outputs.failed: Could not copy. Select the displayed text and copy it manually.

scheduleVisibility.paused: Automatic receipt updates are paused while this page is hidden. Showing only previously observed receipts.
scheduleVisibility.refreshing: Refreshing schedule receipts. Existing entries show their last successful read. No task is being started.
scheduleVisibility.unavailable: Some receipts could not be refreshed. Available entries are last observed values; use Refresh to retry reads.
scheduleVisibility.observed: Showing the last successfully read receipts. Automatic checks run every 15 seconds while this page is visible.

scheduleCreation.scope: Creating a schedule can start future agent runs. After submission, check its receipt before creating another. This page does not provide server-side deduplication; leaving or reloading clears its local recovery state.
scheduleCreation.invalid: Check the required fields, choose a future start time, whole-minute interval (1–525600), and retry limit (0–3).
scheduleCreation.accepted: Creation was acknowledged. The linked ID comes from that response; its current state is read separately.
scheduleCreation.uncertain: Creation was not confirmed. A schedule may already exist. Do not resubmit this request; review your schedules. A matching title or time does not prove which request created it.
scheduleCreation.retained: The submitted fields are retained above. Submitted start time (UTC): {at}.
scheduleCreation.readFailed: Its current receipt could not be confirmed. Refresh retries only the read; it does not create a schedule.
scheduleCreation.observed: Latest schedule readback: {status}. This is not evidence that an agent run succeeded.
scheduleCreation.anotherWarning: A new form creates an additional, independent schedule. The acknowledged schedule remains.

cancellation.title: Cancel task
cancellation.warning: Request cancellation for task {id}? Its history and any retained result remain. Local work is interrupted on a best-effort basis; this does not prove provider execution, tool effects or billing have stopped.
cancellation.accepted: The server accepted cancellation. Check the latest task receipt below.
cancellation.unknown: The cancellation response was not confirmed. The request may have taken effect. Refresh the receipt; do not resubmit or rerun the task.
cancellation.scope: A cancelled receipt records gateway task state. It does not prove remote work stopped or undo effects already produced.
cancellation.readFailed: The current receipt could not be confirmed. Refresh to retry this read only.

description: View async tasks submitted by your account and their execution status
scopeNotice: Only real gateway tasks visible to the current account and tenant appear here. Status comes from runtime data; queue depth and capacity are not inferred.

scheduled.comingSoonDesc: Scheduled tasks feature is under development. You''ll be able to configure automated tasks to run on schedule.
scheduled.loadError: Scheduled tasks could not be loaded. Check that the service and database upgrade are available.
scheduled.actionError: The action failed. Refresh to check its status before retrying.
scheduled.title: Title
scheduled.policy: Tasks use your current permissions at launch. Runs never overlap. Pausing stops future launches; cancellation requests interruption of an active run. Uncertain launches are not retried automatically.
scheduled.uncertainRecovery: The launch outcome is unresolved. Do not create a replacement task yet: it could repeat tool actions. Refresh the receipt and give an administrator the execution and run IDs. Cancellation remains a request until the runtime confirms it.
scheduled.failedRecovery: This run failed after launch and may have performed actions. Review its output before creating another schedule. A recurring schedule may still launch its next occurrence; pause it if needed.
scheduled.preflightRecovery: The schedule is paused after a pre-launch failure. Check the error and resolve access, model or service availability before resuming. Resume allows a new launch when due.
scheduled.preflightReceipt: This attempt failed before launch. Check the schedule status: a bounded pre-launch retry may still be pending.
scheduled.resultScope: Read-only assistant text from this execution''s session. Output may be partial; the execution status determines whether the run succeeded.
scheduled.resultUnavailable: Output could not be loaded. Your access may have changed or the service may be unavailable. Refreshing only reads the result; it does not rerun the task.
scheduled.resultRevoked: Some output is hidden because access to its sources was revoked.
scheduled.resultLimited: Only the latest 200 history messages are available in this view.
scheduled.resultEmpty: No readable assistant text is available yet. This does not mean the run succeeded or had no effects.
scheduled.resultNotice: Execution status and output are available here. Open Updates for durable in-app outcome receipts and read state. No email, push or external notification is sent.
scheduled.invalidLink: This schedule link is invalid. Select a schedule from the list.
scheduled.linkUnavailable: This schedule is unavailable or outside the latest 200 schedules. Check the link and your signed-in account.
scheduled.executionUnavailable: This execution is unavailable or outside the latest 100 executions.
scheduled.historyNotice: Pages show the latest observed receipts, ordered by creation time. Reading or paging never starts a task. Browser Back restores the previous page.
scheduled.invalidHistoryLink: This history link is invalid. Return to Latest or select a schedule.
scheduled.historyReadError: Receipts could not be read. Refresh to retry this read; no task is rerun.
scheduled.legacyHistory: This server does not provide older-page navigation. Only its returned receipts are shown.
scheduled.exactUnavailable: This receipt could not be read with your current access. Check the link, account and service, then refresh. It may require a newer server.
scheduled.linkedOutsidePage: Linked execution, outside the current page

states.initial: Enter a task ID to start querying
states.initialDesc: Query async task status and execution results
states.notFoundDesc: Task ID "{id}" does not exist or has expired
states.errorDesc: Unable to get task info, please check task ID or try again later

inbox.loadFailed: Task inbox could not be loaded
inbox.emptyDescription: Tasks submitted through async services appear here; Assistant chat runs remain managed in their sessions.

partialResult: This task failed or was cancelled. Retained output may be partial; it does not mean the task succeeded or had no effects.
detailResultProvenance: Output from the latest successful task-detail read. This snapshot may be older than the separate result read and does not indicate that read succeeded.
title: Task Management

notifications.title: Scheduled task updates
notifications.scope: Completed, failed and cancelled attempts are saved here. Read state is saved to your account across devices. Opening an update does not mark it read.
notifications.delivery: These are in-app execution receipts. No email, push or external message is sent. Unresolved launches remain in Scheduled until their outcome is known.
notifications.actionError: The read-state change was not confirmed. Refresh to check its state before retrying.
notifications.invalidLink: This update link is invalid. Open an update from your inbox.
notifications.detailUnavailable: This update is unavailable to your account or could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
notifications.loadError: Updates could not be loaded. Check service availability and the scheduled-notification database upgrade, then refresh.
notifications.noUnread: No unread updates on this page.
notifications.empty: No completed task outcomes on this page yet.
notifications.pageNotice: Up to 50 receipts per page. New outcomes appear on the latest page; read changes apply only to the selected receipts.

diagnostics.title: Task diagnosis and handoff

states.pending: The last receipt is pending. Refresh to observe progress; do not submit the task again.
states.processing: The last receipt is processing. Keep observing the same task; this view does not confirm individual tool side effects.
states.completed: The receipt confirms task completion. A separate result-read failure does not change that receipt.
states.failed: The receipt reports failure. Some work or side effects may already have occurred. Check the original workflow before starting another task.
states.cancelled: The receipt reports cancellation. This does not prove that dispatched actions were undone or all execution resources stopped.
states.unknown: The receipt status is not recognized. Refresh and ask an administrator to inspect the task before starting another one.

diagnostics.resultUnavailable: The result endpoint could not be read. Any detail output shown below is a separate authorized observation; do not rerun the task just to recover output.
diagnostics.scope: This panel describes the last authorized task receipt. It does not infer the failure cause or verify remote cancellation, cleanup, or side effects.
diagnostics.previewNotice: Metadata only: inspect this snapshot before sharing it with an administrator. It excludes prompts, results, error text, service names and credentials. Non-UUID task identities are omitted. The preview is a snapshot, not a live status.
diagnostics.failed: Could not copy. Select and copy the preview manually.

scheduleActions.title: Schedule action
scheduleActions.accepted: The server accepted this action. The current state is shown separately below.
scheduleActions.unknown: The action outcome is unknown. Recheck only reads the schedule; it will not resend the action.
scheduleActions.notSent: No action was sent because the schedule changed or its current state could not be verified.
scheduleActions.unavailable: Current schedule status could not be read.
scheduleActions.concurrency: Another tab, user action or scheduler may change this status. A matching status does not prove which request caused it.
scheduleActions.cancelLimit: Cancellation requests the active execution to stop. This does not prove it has stopped or undo effects already produced.
scheduleActions.cancelConfirm: Cancel this schedule and request cancellation of its active execution? Future scheduled runs will stop; existing effects cannot be undone.
